# ui.byronwade.com

> Meridian — cinematic design theme for AIs. Typed grammar. shadcn primitives. Not a custom component zoo.

## For agents

- [Design](https://ui.byronwade.com/design): Designed contract with copy
- [design.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/design.md): Raw AI contract (frozen vs creative)
- [For agents](https://ui.byronwade.com/for-agents): Load order, skills, agents
- [Architecture](https://ui.byronwade.com/architecture): System layers
- Theme grammar lives in-repo at lib/design/

## Showcase

- [Theme](https://ui.byronwade.com/theme): Laws, knobs, closed roles, bans
- [Surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/surfaces): Application · Marketing · Mobile · Desktop
- [Home](https://ui.byronwade.com/): Positioning
- [llms.txt](https://ui.byronwade.com/llms.txt): This file (raw)

## Enforce

- npm run check:design
- TypeScript unions in lib/design/grammar.ts
- Cinematic laws in lib/design/recipes.ts
